_comment: Issue #1486: the manual-gate attestation ledger -- release obligations only a human can discharge (no CI job exists to go red). release.yml's required `attest_manual_gates` input must address every gate that applies to the release: a bare id is VERIFIED against the newest attestation here (max_age_days, the attested commit an ancestor of the release commit, and no watch_paths file changed since it); `<id>=skip:<reason>` is a recorded, reasoned skip. Attestations are appended by the gate's `run` script (--record) and committed -- never hand-edited: each carries the JUnit counts and sha256 proving the test RAN (tests>=1, skipped=0, failures=0) on the required ABI. Validated by `go run ./cmd/releasegatecheck` and `go run ./cmd/manualgatecheck validate`; enforced at dispatch by `go run ./cmd/manualgatecheck check`. Policy + rationale: docs/development/release-gates.md, 'Manual gates'.

gates.name: Android local-only mode on a real arm64 device (LocalOnlyModeE2eTest)
